resource.name: Eastbound Tunnel and Bridge Traffic Monthly Volume, Port Authority of NY NJ:  Beginning 2011
resource.description: The Port Authority collects eastbound vehicle traffic volumes from its toll plazas at the six Port Authority vehicular crossings (i.e., George Washington Bridge, Holland Tunnel, Lincoln Tunnel, Goethals Bridge, Outerbridge Crossing and Bayonne Bridge).  This dataset contains monthly eastbound traffic volumes for each crossing and for all Port Authority crossings combined, based on vehicles passing through Authority’s toll plazas, for each month starting in January 2011 through December 2012.  The dataset contains traffic volumes for three types of vehicles (autos, buses, trucks) for each month.
resource.attribution: The Port Authority of NY & NJ

resource.name: MTA Central Business District Geofence Map
resource.description: This dataset consists of a set of 2D geofence polygons that are intended to capture the Manhattan CBD as defined by the MTA Reform and Traffic Mobility Act. That legislation defines it as the geographic area of Manhattan south of and inclusive of 60th Street, not including the Franklin D. Roosevelt (FDR) Drive and the West Side Highway/Route 9A, the Battery Park Underpass and any surface roadway portion of the Hugh L. Carey Tunnel that connects to West Street (the West Side Highway/Route 9A).
